# Account access

Every employee account requires multifactor authentication.

# Database backups

The database is backed up nightly to an encrypted backup drive.

# Incident reporting

Employees must report suspected security incidents to the incident response team within one hour.

# Visitor badges

Visitors receive a temporary badge at reception and must return it when they leave.

# Password resets

The help desk handles password resets after verifying the employee's identity.

# Laptop disposal

Retired laptops are wiped and sent to a certified electronics recycler.
